import sys

data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
n = data[0]
heights = data[1:]

events = [(0, 1), (heights[0], -1)]

for i in range(1, n):
    if heights[i] > heights[i - 1]:
        events.append((heights[i - 1], 1))
        events.append((heights[i], -1))

events.sort()

active = best = 0
i = 0
while i < len(events):
    height = events[i][0]
    delta = 0
    while i < len(events) and events[i][0] == height:
        delta += events[i][1]
        i += 1
    active += delta
    best = max(best, active)

print(best + 1)
